raw_sections.summary:
CAREER OBJECTIVE:
Professional with strong background in financial analysis, adept at leveraging analytical skills to
drive business growth and financial stability. Expertise in data interpretation, financial
modelling, and risk assessment, ensuring informed decision-making and strategic planning.
Known for collaborative approach and adaptability, consistently meeting team objectives and
organizational goals. Proficient in utilizing financial software and tools to streamline processes
and enhance accuracy.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:
Company: Prolax IT Solution Pvt Ltd Duration: 1st June 2023 - 29th May 2026 - Hyderabad (Immediate Joiner) Process: Fund Accounting (Mutual funds) Designation: Senior Financial Analyst/B2
Work Experience:
Reconciliations of cash, Stock, FX and income on TLM tool
Processing Trades and reconcile with custody team
Calculated valuations for reporting to investors and Net Asset Value (NAV)
Daily, weekly and monthly activities, separately assessed individual accounts and handle reconciliations between internal accounting system, trading system and custodians.
Validating all corporate actions and taking appropriate action.
Effective chase of aged breaks (un-reconciled items).
Have made use of several tools such as TLM, Bloomberg, FTS, Fund master, PRS etc
Posting trades manually into enterprises and reconciliation with custody
Company: Bank of New York Mellon Pvt Ltd – Pune Duration: 22nd Mar 2021 – 31st Jul 2022 Process: Fund Accounting (Mutual funds) Designation: Senior Financial Analyst
Work Experience:
Accounting Flow of various ledger posting
Resolving breaks in Contract compare Reconciliation though liaising with traders,
onshore, offshore, Counterparty and internal teams. Key focus to resolve each and every
break to through root cause analysis to avoid them further and finding out a solution to
clear them. Communicating with internal or external business partners (Recon, Trade,
Cash, and Income & Custody) to resolve fund related issues.
Experienced in pre and post trade settlement process and analysis.
Trained new analysts on corporate policies and procedures and implemented mentoring
program, reducing on boarding time.
Created and maintained precise and accurate models, charts and reports.
Company: State Street Global Advisors, Bangalore Duration: 1st Feb 2018 to 06th March 2020 Process: Reconciliation and Fund Accounting (NAV) Designation: Associate 2
Work Experience:
Net asset Value calculation of various funds
Fixed and variable expenses accruals verification.
Analysing Market Value of Portfolio and Calculation Unrealized Appreciation & Depreciation
Validating all corporate actions (Stock split, Rights issue, Stock dividend etc.) and taking appropriate action.
Preparing Fund level financial statements of State street‘s clients which is part of Financial Administration service.
Setting up calls with clients as per requirement and communicating the queries and
issues concerned to process and conclude with a solution.
Company: Northern Operating Services Trust Pvt Ltd, Pune Duration: 8th Aug 2016 to 14th Aug 2017 (1 year) Process: IRFA (Ireland Fund Accounting) Designation: Analyst
Work Experience:
Calculated valuations for reporting to investors and Net Asset Value (NAV)
Performing Monthly Daily and Weekly funds valuation
Daily, weekly and monthly activities, separately assessed individual accounts and handle
reconciliations between internal accounting system, trading system and custodians.
Communicate concerns clearly with custodians, internal operational team members and
relationship managers to resolve issues.
Effective chase of aged breaks (un-reconciled items).
Have made use of several tools such as TLM, Bloomberg, FTS, Fund master, PRS etc.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process
improvement and increased efficiency.
